stem.text: The diagram represents part of an alginic acid molecule. Alginic acid is a polymer found in the cell walls of brown seaweeds.

stem.alt: Displayed formula of a repeating polymer unit with two six-membered rings joined by an oxygen bridge, in square brackets with subscript n, with COOH, OH and H groups labelled.

stem.text: Which statement about alginic acid is correct?

A.text: Alginic acid is a linear polysaccharide containing 1,6 glycosidic bonds between each hexose sugar.

B.text: Alginic acid is formed from two monomers joined by 1,4 glycosidic bonds.

C.text: Alternate monosaccharides are arranged in opposite directions; this is also seen in glycogen molecules.

D.text: Hexose sugars and water molecules are joined by condensation reactions to make alginic acid.
